meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli TCP daemon. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 Signal 通道收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用 Signal 做消息通道
copy.tagline_en: Send and receive messages via Signal channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Signal as a messaging channel

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 Signal 收发消息，处理私聊和群聊，支持 Markdown 格式、引用回复和打字指示器。
howto.when: 当用户向绑定的 Signal 号码发送消息时触发。需要先完成注册和配置。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的天气。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Signal 回复天气信息。

say.text: 在群里说：会议改到下午3点。
say.note: Claude 会在群聊中发送消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages via Signal, handle DMs and group chats, and supports Markdown formatting, quoted replies, and typing indicators.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the linked Signal number. Requires prior registration and configuration.

say_en.note: Claude will reply with weather info via Signal.

say_en.text: In the group, say: Meeting moved to 3 PM.
say_en.note: Claude will send the message in the group chat.
